from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3,re,sys

ROOT=Path("/media/domenicleonetti/easystore/EIRA/LIVE")
SRC=ROOT/"eira2/evidence/universe_public_library.py"
DB=ROOT/"eira_probe/universe_library/source_vault/source_index.sqlite3"

EXPECTED=[
"receipt_id","source_name","operation","started_unix",
"completed_unix","status","details_json"
]

def fail(msg):
    print("LIBRARY_CONTRACT_GUARD=FAIL",msg)
    raise SystemExit(1)

if not SRC.is_file(): fail("source_missing")
if not DB.is_file(): fail("database_missing")

with sqlite3.connect(DB) as db:
    cols=[r[1] for r in db.execute(
        "PRAGMA table_info(ingest_receipts)"
    )]

if cols != EXPECTED:
    fail("sqlite_schema="+repr(cols))

s=SRC.read_text()

if "ingest_receipts VALUES(" in s:
    fail("unsafe_positional_receipt_insert")

pattern=(
 r"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO ingest_receipts"
 r"\s*\(receipt_id,source_name,operation,started_unix,"
 r"\s*completed_unix,status,details_json\)"
 r"\s*VALUES\(\?,\?,\?,\?,\?,\?,\?\)"
)

if len(re.findall(pattern,s)) < 2:
    fail("explicit_7_column_writers_missing")

compile(s,str(SRC),"exec")

print("LIBRARY_CONTRACT_GUARD=PASS")
print("SQLITE_COLUMNS=7")
print("WRITER_PLACEHOLDERS=7")
